# crosswork_backup_destination (Resource)

This resource can manage the remote backup destination (SFTP server) of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_backup_destination" "example" {
  host_name           = "192.0.2.10"
  port                = 22
  username            = "cwtest"
  password_wo         = "cwtest-password"
  password_wo_version = 1
  remote_path         = "/backups"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_name` (String) IPv4 address or host name of the SFTP server
- `port` (Number) SSH port of the SFTP server
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `remote_path` (String) Directory on the SFTP server that receives the backups
- `username` (String) User name for the SFTP server

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the SFTP user
  - **Required**: exactly one of `password` and `password_wo` must be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `password_wo` together with `password_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password of the SFTP user
  - **Required**: exactly one of `password` and `password_wo` must be set.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `password_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_backup_destination.example "backup_destination"
```
